# ARC NCGP Research Points Planner (13-Point System)

> Static, zero-backend client-side planning workbench for Australian researchers modelling multi-year grant pipelines under the Australian Research Council (ARC) National Competitive Grants Program (NCGP) 13-point system (2027-2032). Unofficial tool; rules verified November 2026. All user data stays in browser `localStorage` with zero server storage.

## Structured Data

- [rules.json](/rules.json): Complete machine-readable definitions of all 8 NCGP schemes, 4 legacy 0-point schemes, role point weights, indicative launch windows, durations, funding bands, eligibility cutoffs, changelog, and official ARC URLs.

## How to Use This Website

1. **Build Your Grant Pipeline (2027-2032):** Click `+ Add Grant` (or the inline `+ Add a grant or legacy project...` row) to add planned NCGP bids, already-awarded NCGP grants (locked in RMS with no pending phase), or 0-point legacy ARC grants (`DP`, `LP`, `DECRA`, `FT`). Default labels stay generic (e.g. `Explore #1`) so unpublished titles never need to be entered.
2. **Stress-Test Plan A vs. Plan B:** Click any `If Funded` / `If Unfunded` pill in a grant row to toggle whether that bid locks points through its project end date or releases points on its outcome announcement date.
3. **Check Remaining Capacity (`What Fits?` tab):** Click any quarter column (`Q1 2027` to `Q4 2032`) on the timeline or capacity bar chart. The `What Fits?` tab lists every valid scheme + role combination within your free point balance, with filters for eligibility and multi-year cap breaches, plus 1-click `+ Add`.
4. **Compare Scenarios & Templates:** Use the scenario tabs (`+ New Scenario`, duplicate, rename) and `Compare` modal to inspect side-by-side quarterly load heatmaps, or load starter plans via `Templates` (`Fresh Postdoc / ECR`, `Mid-Career Researcher`, `Senior Lead`).
5. **Check Eligibility Cutoffs (`Eligibility`):** Enter PhD conferral date and career interruption months to draw the 5-year ECR cutoff line (when inside 2027-2032) and flag ineligible roles (`Initiate`, `SCI (ECR)`). Enable `Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Researcher` to unlock `Indigenous Excellence` / `SCI (MCR)` and plot the 15-year post-PhD cutoff line.
6. **Check Collaborator Headroom (`Team / Co-CI` tab & `Profile:` switcher):** Add any number of Co-CI profiles manually or via a colleague's Shareable URL (`Import Link`). Pick one of your planned bids and the Co-CI's role to inspect their 2027-2032 visual overlap chart, add/edit their grants with the full Grant Modal, or click `Full timeline` (or the Row 2 `Profile:` bar) to inspect their complete workbench.
7. **Override Rules or Export (`Rules` & `Export / AI`):** Locally override the 13-point cap, role weights, or launch quarters for hypothetical testing; export slide-ready PNGs, Print/PDF layouts, `.ics` calendars, JSON backups, privacy-safe `#plan=...` share URLs (auto-stripping custom titles by default), or copy Markdown/JSON summaries for AI assistants.

## AI Agent Integration (WebMCP & Browser Automation)

In WebMCP-enabled browsers exposing `document.modelContext` or `navigator.modelContext`, this app automatically registers 7 client-side tools (check live browser readiness under `Export / AI` -> `AI Agent Endpoints & Browser-Native WebMCP`):

- `get_current_plan` (read-only): Returns active profile, scenario, grants, 2027-2032 quarterly point loads, peak load, over-cap quarters, funding roll-up, and eligibility issues.
- `get_rules` (read-only): Returns active `rules.json` configuration (including any local custom overrides).
- `find_fitting_roles` (read-only, `{ quarter?: "YYYY-Q1..Q4" }`): Lists valid scheme + role options that fit remaining points in the target quarter.
- `add_grant` (`{ schemeId, roleId, submissionQuarter?, durationYears?, outcome?, isAwarded?, label? }`): Adds an NCGP or `legacy-*` grant to the active scenario.
- `remove_grant` (`{ grantId }`): Removes a grant by ID.
- `toggle_funded_status` (`{ grantId, outcome?: "funded" | "unsuccessful" }`): Toggles or sets a grant's modelled outcome.
- `switch_scenario` (`{ scenario }`): Switches the active scenario tab by ID or name.

Browser agents without WebMCP can operate the UI directly through standard ARIA landmarks, buttons, `<dialog>` modals, and form controls, or read `/rules.json` directly.

## Core ARC 13-Point Rules (Verified Nov 2026)

- **Hard Cap:** 13 Research Points per investigator across pending and active NCGP grants.
- **Point Lifecycle:**
  - **Pending (Submitted):** Points lock on the submission/closing date and remain locked until outcome announcement.
  - **Active (Funded):** Points remain locked continuously until the official project end date.
  - **Released:** Points return on the outcome date if unsuccessful, or after the project end date when completed.
  - **No Early Relinquishment:** Active projects and roles cannot be relinquished early to free up Research Points.
- **Legacy Grants (0 Points):** Existing Discovery/Linkage grants (DP, LP, DECRA, FT) consume 0 Research Points and can be plotted for workload visibility.
- **Teaching Relief:** Unsalaried Chief Investigators (CI, Lead CI, Node Lead CI, Lead CI/Director) are eligible for up to $50,000/year in teaching relief. Teaching relief cannot be combined with an SCI salary.
- **Eligibility Windows:**
  - **ECR Cutoff:** 5 years post-PhD conferral (adjusted for career interruptions) for Initiate Fellowships and SCI (ECR) roles.
  - **Indigenous Excellence:** Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander researchers up to 15 years post-PhD; the only scheme offering SCI (MCR).

## Scheme & Role Matrix

- **[Explore](https://www.arc.gov.au/funding-research/applying-grant/new-ncgp-schemes-overview/explore)** (Confirmed, Q1 2027 Mar, Annual, 3 yrs, $50k-$400k/yr): Lead CI (5), CI (3), SCI (ECR) (8).
- **[Initiate Fellowships](https://www.arc.gov.au/funding-research/applying-grant/new-ncgp-schemes-overview/initiate-fellowships)** (Indicative, Q2 2027, Annual, 3 yrs, Salary + up to $50k/yr): Lead CI (8).
- **[Lead & Mentor](https://www.arc.gov.au/funding-research/applying-grant/new-ncgp-schemes-overview/lead-and-mentor)** (Indicative, Q3 2027, Annual, 5 yrs, Up to $250k/yr + 2 postdocs + 2 HDRs): Lead CI/Director (7, no salary), SCI (ECR) (8).
- **[Indigenous Excellence](https://www.arc.gov.au/funding-research/applying-grant/new-ncgp-schemes-overview/indigenous-excellence)** (Indicative, Q4 2027, Annual, 5 yrs, $50k-$500k/yr): Lead CI (5), CI (3), SCI (ECR) (8), SCI (MCR) (8).
- **[Collaborate](https://www.arc.gov.au/funding-research/applying-grant/new-ncgp-schemes-overview/collaborate)** (Indicative, Q1 2028, Biennial, 5 yrs, $1m-$2m/yr): Lead CI/Director (7), Node Lead CI (5), CI (3), SCI (ECR) (8).
- **[CIEF](https://www.arc.gov.au/funding-research/applying-grant/new-ncgp-schemes-overview/collaborate-infrastructure-equipment-and-facilities-cief)** (Indicative Sub-scheme, Q2 2028, Annual, 5 yrs, Co-funded infrastructure): Lead CI (4), CI (2).
- **[Breakthrough](https://www.arc.gov.au/funding-research/applying-grant/new-ncgp-schemes-overview/breakthrough)** (Indicative, Q3 2028, Annual, 5 yrs, $200k-$600k/yr): Lead CI (5), CI (3), SCI (ECR) (8).
- **[Prioritise](https://www.arc.gov.au/funding-research/applying-grant/new-ncgp-schemes-overview/prioritise)** (Indicative, Q4 2028 EOI / Q2 2029 Full, Biennial, 7 yrs, $4m-$6m/yr): Lead CI/Director (7), Node Lead CI (5), CI (3), SCI (ECR) (8).
